dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your streaming automation, rebuilt.
dashboard.quickstart: Open Automations to build a sequence, or Profiles to bind triggers to it.
dashboard.empty: Empty dashboard — click Edit, then Add widget.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.selectHint: Select a profile to edit it, or create one.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.activationHint: Boolean expression over state. Empty means always active.
profiles.noTriggers: No triggers bound. Add one to run an automation on an event.

webview.title: Webview
webview.none: No overlays yet — create one to compose a browser source.
webview.dropHint: Add a widget, then drag to place and resize it.
webview.urlHint: Add this as a Browser source in OBS.
webview.placeholder: Browser-source overlays (fed live state over websocket) and remote control interfaces will live here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Applies immediately across the whole app.
settings.pearHint: Address of the Pear / YouTube Music player's local API (default 127.0.0.1:26538).
settings.obsHint: obs-websocket address (default 127.0.0.1:4455) and its password (Tools → WebSocket Server Settings in OBS).
settings.twitchEnterCode: Enter this code on Twitch to authorise Quicktys:
settings.twitchWaiting: Waiting for your approval… this window updates on its own.
settings.twitchHint: Register an application on dev.twitch.tv/console/apps to get a Client ID (client type: public — no secret needed). The code can also be entered from your phone.

marketplace.emptyBrowse: No results. Refresh the registry, then search.
marketplace.consentHint: Grant or revoke each module's system capabilities. Revoking takes effect immediately.

licenses.intro: Paste a license key to unlock a paid extension. Keys are verified offline.
licenses.needed: This is a paid extension — add its license key here to install it.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Quicktys
onboarding.intro: Install a few plugins to get started. You can add or remove more anytime from the Marketplace.
onboarding.empty: No registry configured yet. Set QUICKTYS_REGISTRY (or add one in the Marketplace) to install plugins.
onboarding.welcome: Quicktys automates your stream with plugins, modules and widgets.

setup.title: Set up your extensions
setup.settingsIntro: Fill in the settings for what you just installed.
setup.permsIntro: Grant the system permissions each module needs.
